 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Moksha Khajuria Kazmi, Judge
 Order

1. In the instant petition, the petitioners herein are seeking quashment of the Notice No. 975/OQ dated 22.10.2024, issued by respondent No. 6-Tehsildar Bhaderwah with a further direction to the respondents not to construct a Road from Chinar Mohalla to Qilla Mohalla Bhaderwah on the land of the petitioners falling under Khasra No. 1387 min/1208 min, Khewat No. 751/752 situated at Kahi Mohalla Nagar, Bhaderwah which is owned and is in possession of the petitioners, without adopting due process of law, under the Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the respondents are intending to construct the road on the proprietary land of the petitioners without adopting due procedure of law.
3. Issue notice to the respondents in the main petition as well as in CM.
4.
